text:
frank: heads-up: found another confusing case for new Go SDK users. If they cancel ctx during the generator handshake, their sampleapp process can hang.

frank: short repro: create generator, start Events() consumer, cancel immediately. Sometimes the consumer goroutine stays stuck reading from the decoder and process lingers.

nina: is this the same auth-refresh/context-shim issue we fixed earlier? iirc we had a retry goroutine that didn't inherit the caller ctx.

frank: similar class but different trigger: even without auth refresh, if middleware or retry code creates a child ctx and we don't wire the request with req.WithContext(parent) right before RoundTrip, cancellation might not reach the transport. the read loop also never checks ctx.Done(), so it won't bail early.

omar: actionable fixes: (1) always set req = req.WithContext(g.ctx) immediately before RoundTrip; (2) stop detached goroutines for retry/refresh, use errgroup.WithContext so they cancel together; (3) add Generator.Close() that cancels internal context and closes Events channel; (4) change read loop to select on ctx.Done() before blocking read.

nina: +1. UX note: document that callers should either cancel the ctx OR call gen.Close(). probably add a one-line example in the SDK README: defer gen.Close().

frank: i put a tiny patch together: gen-close-idiom-2026. It stores an internal cancel on the generator struct, swaps retries to errgroup, ensures req.WithContext, and updates decoder loop to be cancellable. Local sampleapp no longer hangs.

ci-bot: CI queued for gen-close-idiom-2026 (build #4788).

omar: tests: i recommend an integration that cancels mid-handshake and asserts the process exits within 200ms. Avoid relying on NumGoroutine counts. Also add a small unit that ensures Close() is idempotent.

nina: also add a short comment in the auth/ctx shim explaining why we removed the inner child ctx. historical context reduces regression risk.

frank: i'll update the sampleapp README with a note and add the tiny integration test. i'll include the minimal repro snippet in the PR description so reviewers can run it locally.

ci-bot: Build started for gen-close-idiom-2026 (build #4788).

nina: follow-up: let's do a quick cross-SDK doc sweep so JS/Py examples mention the same close-or-cancel pattern. create a short cross-sdk issue after this lands.

frank: good call. thanks all — hoping this reduces first-run friction for Go users.
